items.title: 66096_Monk Montgomery oral history interview
items.q: It was Freddie Hubbard and Pookie and Punchy, Joe something on piano and Paul Parker on drums, and the three brothers. They were the five others.

ctx.x: No, that was earlier. And Wes somehow wasn't able to attract any attention. He just didn't have any luck. In fact, he came to San Francisco and he had his trio, and he worked some around town. It was an organ trio, with Melvin
They did make a record together, though.
